description: This file defines the 'Links' class in the SuiteCRM JSON API v1, responsible for constructing and serializing link-related data for API responses, including pagination and related links.

classes.name: Links
classes.description: A class for managing and serializing JSON API link objects, including pagination and related links, with URL validation and logging.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the Links class.

methods.name: withSelf
methods.description: Sets the 'self' URL after validating it.

methods.name: withFirst
methods.description: Sets the 'first' pagination URL after validation.

methods.name: withPrev
methods.description: Sets the 'prev' pagination URL after validation.

methods.name: withNext
methods.description: Sets the 'next' pagination URL after validation.

methods.name: withLast
methods.description: Sets the 'last' pagination URL after validation.

methods.name: withMeta
methods.description: Merges provided meta data into existing meta.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Serializes the link object into a JSON API response array.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the logger instance, creating a default if none is set.
